verdict.rationale: Elicit is a SaaS AI research tool, so a training opt-out or no-training data policy is a fair question for this kind of product and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack covers model-training data usage, training opt-outs, or a no-training commitment. The pack covers only workflow, export, API, and collaboration features.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
